alex (sales): New RFP POC from a Nordic bank: they require CAIQ responses, a dataflow that proves EU-only processing, subprocessor disclosure, and KMS/HSM options. Deadline Tuesday noon. Can we mobilize?
hari (security): I can help. Need to know if they mandate customer-owned KMS or if keywrap acceptable. Also confirm whether logs/metrics may leave EU if pseudonymized.
tara (solutions): We should give them three configurations: hosted-eu (eu-west-1) with keywrap, dedicated-reserved with BYOK and HSM option, and private on-prem for full isolation. I'll craft a one-page comparison and a dataflow ascii.
claire (product): I'll pull latest CAIQ export and mark controls that depend on deployment mode. We'll annotate with a cover letter if they need signed attestation.
upload-bot: upload-bot uploaded file: /internal/artifacts/caij-2026-03-25.pdf
alex (sales): They also asked for explicit evidence that backups and logs are stored in EU for the POC. Can we provide screenshots or console exports?
hari (security): Yes, we can provide a screenshot of bucket region and an export of storage ACLs showing eu-west-1. Also add deletion playbook.
tara (solutions): ascii flow to include:
```
Client(EU) -> Ingress (eu) -> Router -> Inference Nodes (eu)
Inference -> Logs (PII-filter) -> EU Object Store
Inference -> Metrics (scrubbed) -> EU Monitoring
KMS: optional customer-managed -> keywrap -> inference nodes
Post-POC: run delete-snapshots.sh & s3 purge job
```
alex (sales): Great. I'll collect attachments and send to customer. Pricing question: if they want dedicated 2x H100 for 3 weeks is there a quick number? I'll DM infra team.
hari (security): I'll update CAIQ answers and attach the subprocessor CSV. Marked prod vs poc-only.
alex (sales): Thanks everyone. I'll upload to their secure portal by Tuesday AM.
